subject: Security acceptance sprint: Pinnacle Bank MAP & DPA alignment
messages:
From: Erin Walker <erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinnaclebank.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: security gates / DPA / retention windows

Mateo — thanks for the fast follow. Attaching our first-pass MAP (pinnacle_map_draft_v2.xlsx). High level the security/compliance items that must land in phase 1 are: SOC 2 evidence for the hosting environment, SIG/CAIQ self-assessment, executed DPA with our standard data retention and deletion windows, and confirmation of audit/log access paths.

Proposed target: signoff on security items by 2025-09-05 so we can proceed to pilot in September. Can Redwood commit to a sprint to get the evidence index and DPA redline back by end of next week?

Questions we need you to confirm in your next note:
- Which team owns the SOC 2 artifact pull (Redwood: Security/Compliance leads?)
- Do you have CAIQ completed or do we schedule a questionnaire walkthrough?
- For data retention we expect a default 365-day log retention for audit data; can you confirm hosted API vs private deployment differences (90d vs 365d)?

Thanks — can we set a 30-min call next Tue (8/19) to run through the MAP and owners?

Erin Walker
VP, Risk & Compliance | Pinnacle Bank
Erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com
Attachment: pinnacle_map_draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walker <erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates / DPA / retention windows

Thanks Erin — appreciate the clarity and the MAP. We can own coordination on the SOC 2 artifact collection and produce an evidence index for you. Next-step commitments from Redwood: 

- Evidence index (SOC 2) delivered: 2025-08-20 (we will provide a zipped index and links)
- CAIQ: Jonas will run a live walkthrough or provide the self-assessment by 2025-08-22
- DPA redlines: Kimberly/legal to provide initial redline back by 2025-08-21
- Data retention: proposed options below (we need you to pick):
    • Hosted API: operational logs retained 90 days, audit logs retained 365 days (default)
    • Private/VPC: customer-controlled retention; Redwood can support 90/365 or configurable windows via config flag

We agree to push for your 2025-09-05 signoff target. Adding the attachments we discussed: evidence_index_SOC2.zip (placeholder with manifest).

A few acceptance criteria questions so we align:
1) For SOC 2, do you need full testwork evidence or snapshot artifacts (policy + sample reports)?
2) For CAIQ, are you okay with a Redwood self-assessment validated in the walkthrough, or do you require third-party attestation?
3) DPA: which clause is non-negotiable for Pinnacle (data residency, subprocessors, breach notice timeline)?

If those are OK I’ll lock owners in the MAP and send a short milestone tracker.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: evidence_index_SOC2.zip (manifest file)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walker <erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates / DPA / retention windows

Erin — quick note from legal/ops. Attached is an initial DPA redline (dpa_redlines_v1.docx). Key points we plan to address in the redline:
- Data residency addendum: Redwood can commit to US-only processing for Pinnacle under the Private deployment; hosted will be region-limited (us-east) unless otherwise requested.
- Subprocessors: we will provide our subprocessors list and an SLA for data access requests; we prefer a notification + cure period for new subprocessors.
- Retention & deletion: proposed default retention is 365 days for audit logs; operational traces may be configured down to 90 days for hosted tiers. We can add a contractual retention schedule with exceptions (legal holds).
- Breach notification: 72 hours notification window; we can provide daily updates until resolved.

On the SOC 2 artifacts: we will provide the control-objective mapping and sample evidence (policies, config screenshots, control tests) in the evidence index. If you require the full SOC 2 report we can provide it under NDA once procurement is complete.

I’ll track redline comments in the Drive link Mateo shared and aim to have the first pass back 2025-08-21.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: dpa_redlines_v1.docx (document)

From: Erin Walker <erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinnaclebank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates / DPA / retention windows

Thanks Mateo/Kimberly — that plan looks actionable. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we need policy + control evidence + sample test artifacts (snapshot) for phase 1; full report under NDA is optional for later.
- CAIQ: please provide the self-assessment document ahead of the walkthrough so our team can pre-read.
- Retention: Pinnacle prefers audit logs retained 365 days; if hosted ops wants 90-day access logs, that’s acceptable as long as audit-level logs remain 365d. Please reflect this in the MAP matrix.

Tom and I are available for a 30-min walkthrough Tuesday 2025-08-19 at 11:00 ET. Can Redwood confirm? HubSpot deal RB-DEAL-4821 is tracking the MAP milestones.

Erin Walker
VP, Risk & Compliance | Pinnacle Bank
Attachment: none
Related: HubSpot deal RB-DEAL-4821

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walker <erin.walker@pinnaclebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates / DPA / retention windows

> Thanks Mateo/Kimberly — that plan looks actionable. A couple clarifications from our side: 
> 
> - SOC 2: we need policy + control evidence + sample test artifacts (snapshot) for phase 1; full report under NDA is optional for later.
> - CAIQ: please provide the self-assessment document ahead of the walkthrough so our team can pre-read.
> - Retention: Pinnacle prefers audit logs retained 365 days; if hosted ops wants 90-day access logs, that’s acceptable as long as audit-level logs remain 365d. Please reflect this in the MAP matrix.

Thanks Erin — all confirmed. Summary and owners (locking into the MAP):

Milestones / Owners / Target dates:
- Evidence index (SOC 2 snapshot) — Owner: Mateo (Security Ops) — Due: 2025-08-20
- CAIQ self-assessment + pre-read — Owner: Jonas (Applied ML/InfoSec) — Due: 2025-08-22
- DPA redline first pass — Owner: Kimberly (Legal) — Due: 2025-08-21
- Walkthrough call (MAP review) — Owner: Mateo — 2025-08-19 11:00 ET (confirmed)
- Security signoff (phase 1) — Owner: Pinnacle (Erin) + Redwood — Target: 2025-09-05

Acceptance notes: SOC 2 snapshot artifacts and CAIQ pre-read will be uploaded to the Drive folder above. We will mark evidence items as: policy / config screenshot / sample test output / control mapping. Where the full report is required we will request NDA and provide the report under controlled access.

Next actions (today):
- I’ll upload evidence index and CAIQ pre-read links by EOD 2025-08-18.
- Kimberly will post DPA redline to the Drive link and tag comments for Erin/Tom.

If that matches your expectations I’ll add the milestone timeline to HubSpot (RB-DEAL-4821) and share a single-page MAP with owners and deadlines.

Best — looking forward to the walkthrough.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment references: evidence_index_SOC2.zip, dpa_redlines_v1.docx
